title: Aureline M5 cohort descriptor
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for the core-team canary and design-partner preview cohorts. Names the cohort class, the entry gate a launch-bearing lane must clear, whether known limits were published before widening, the armed rollback-stop rule, and the ring-progression rule so no stable claim skips cohorts and ring widening depends on current known-limits and rollback-stop rules rather than tribal memory. Downstream shiproom, release-center, executive-steering, program-governance, docs, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a cohort's membership and widening posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
